files.description: Repository conventions: multi-module layout, build/test/lint commands, architecture of the Sender interface and its wrappers (Mailer, pool, AsyncSender, middleware), docs-site workflow.
Package-level overview: features, quick start, pooling, middleware, DKIM signing, async sending, provider adapters, security notes.
The Sender interface and the Email builder/validator that every backend and middleware operates on, including the CRLF-injection checks other rules reference.
The linter ruleset already enforced in CI; avoid duplicating what golangci-lint already flags.
Documents real past security fixes (CRLF injection, TLS 1.2 enforcement, Mailer deep-copy bug) that motivate several of the scoped rules.
